rows.definition: contextEvent is the per-served-turn boolean that marks whether the gateway observed a context-management event, such as compaction or ctxview planning, while logging inference usage.
rows.distinction: It is the event flag for one gateway turn, not the aggregate ContextEvents counters used in vCache/session reports.

rows.definition: ContextBaselineTokens is the token count that would have been spent without the witnessed context-shedding event, used as the baseline side of vCache context savings reports.
rows.distinction: It is the without-context-control baseline, not ContextCostTokens, which is the after-control paid token count.

rows.definition: ContextCostTokens is the token count paid after context-control pruning or compaction has run, reported beside ContextBaselineTokens to compute realized context savings.
rows.distinction: It is the after-control cost, not ContextShedTokens, which counts the tokens removed by the context action.

rows.definition: ContextDroppedTurns counts conversation turns removed or elided by a context-control event and carried into vCache/context witness summaries.
rows.distinction: It counts dropped turns, not ContextShedTokens, which counts token volume shed.

rows.definition: ContextShedTokens records the number of context tokens removed by compaction or ctxview-family controls and surfaced in vCache/context witness reports.
rows.distinction: It is the saved-token volume, not ContextCostTokens, which records the post-shed paid amount.

rows.definition: TopLongContext is the compact-session audit slice of the highest-pressure long-context sessions, ordered for reporting and action planning.
rows.distinction: It is the selected report rows for operator attention, not the longContextPressure recommendation that decides whether an action is warranted.

rows.definition: CompactionSnapshotData is the gateway/debug snapshot payload that records compaction and context-view data for diagnostics and vCache family reporting.
rows.distinction: It is a serialized diagnostic snapshot, not the compaction operation itself.

rows.definition: DefaultContextPath resolves the well-known per-user path where the context witness snapshot is read or written for vCache status and snapshot helpers.
rows.distinction: It is a filesystem path resolver for context witness state, not the context window or context budget itself.

rows.definition: DiscussionContext is the canonicalizer/normgate notion of user discussion context, used to distinguish conversational content from other canonicalization inputs.
rows.distinction: It is a content-channel label for normalization, not the gateway's managed runtime context window.

rows.definition: fakContextValue is the gateway/MCP helper surface that returns the current fak context-value snapshot for status and context-view clients.
rows.distinction: It is the route/helper that serves context value state, not the ctxvalue package or the context value data model as a whole.

rows.definition: logInferenceTurnWithContextEvent is the gateway metrics helper that records one inference turn and includes whether a context event occurred on that turn.
rows.distinction: It logs the turn and context-event bit; it is not the contextEvent boolean itself nor the vCache aggregate counters.

rows.definition: longContextPressure is the sessionaudit recommendation path that turns high long-context usage or I/O ratio into a compact-session action.
rows.distinction: It is the pressure classifier/recommendation, not the TopLongContext rows it reads from.

rows.definition: TotalContextTokens is the sessionaudit aggregate field summing context-token usage across the included sessions or turns.
rows.distinction: It is an aggregate total over sessions, not the per-turn ContextTokens usage field.

rows.definition: CompactActionPlan is the sessionaudit action-plan object containing compact-session recommendations, counts, and optional gate output for recent session pressure.
rows.distinction: It is an operator action list derived from a compact report, not a ctxplan resident Plan or a model-routing plan.

rows.definition: BuildCompactActionPlan lowers a compact-session report into the concrete CompactActionPlan actions a CLI or gateway surface can render or gate.
rows.distinction: It builds session-audit actions, not a general BuildPlan action planner nor a ctxplan PlanCells resident view.

rows.definition: dispatchauto.PlanAuto folds live worker ceilings into an automatic dispatch-wave plan, including target, refill, binding ceiling, and per-worker context slice.
rows.distinction: It plans fleet dispatch capacity, not model memory placement or ctxplan conversation materialization.

rows.definition: ApplyProviderActionPlan applies the local, no-provider-call effects of a vCache ProviderActionPlan to the fak-owned provider manifest and emits an apply report.
rows.distinction: It mutates local provider-cache policy rows, not the sessionaudit CompactActionPlan nor a ctxplan view.

rows.definition: BlockingCandidates is the dispatch-status list of candidate work items that an active lease blocks from being launched safely.
rows.distinction: It is the concrete blocked-candidate list on a lease row, not the boolean BlocksCandidate summary flag.

rows.definition: BlocksCandidate is the dispatch-status tri-state flag indicating whether a live lease blocks any currently available candidate work.
rows.distinction: It is the yes/no blocker flag, not the BlockingCandidates list that names which candidates are blocked.

rows.definition: CandidateSourceAvailable records whether dispatch-status had a candidate source to compare live leases against when classifying blockers.
rows.distinction: It is source-availability metadata for blocker classification, not a candidate item or candidate score.

rows.definition: PlannedCreates is the dogfood issue sync receipt count of issue records the planner intended to create.
rows.distinction: It is a planned creation count in the issue-sync receipt, not a Plan object or candidate planner.

rows.definition: PlanPlacementForDisk evaluates a cachemeta placement request against the filesystem-backed disk tier and returns the placement decision for that tier.
rows.distinction: It plans against the disk tier only, not PlanPlacementForLocalLadder, which evaluates the local HBM/DRAM/disk ladder together.

rows.definition: PlanPlacementForLocalLadder evaluates a cachemeta placement request across the local HBM, DRAM, and disk tiers using live capacity probes.
rows.distinction: It plans across the local tier ladder, not the disk-only PlanPlacementForDisk helper.

rows.definition: PlanView is the typed ctxplan query result returned to the model, carrying selected and elided spans, cost, releases, and assumption state around an embedded Plan.
rows.distinction: It is a projection of a planned view for model inspection, not the PlanCells selector itself.

rows.definition: refuseEPPlanIfUnfit checks whether an expert-parallel serving plan fits the selected serve configuration and refuses startup when the plan is not viable.
rows.distinction: It is a serve-time validation guard over an EP plan, not the planner that estimates model memory placement.

rows.definition: internal/toolprocgate is the in-kernel result-admission and supervisor gate that tracks spawned tool processes, session-end orphan boundaries, kills, and late-result quarantine.
rows.distinction: It is the tool-process lifecycle and result gate, not the generic ResultAdmitter interface nor repo-guard's filesystem write guard.

rows.definition: ApplyCompactActionGate stamps a thresholded gate verdict onto a CompactActionPlan so high or medium session-audit actions can be refused or surfaced consistently.
rows.distinction: It gates compact-session actions, not generic tool-call admission and not the CompactActionPlan data itself.

rows.definition: ActionGate is the session-summary option or report field carrying the compact-action gate threshold used when rendering recent session actions.
rows.distinction: It is the threshold setting/value, not the ApplyCompactActionGate function that evaluates it.

rows.definition: guardBannerBuildStamp returns the embedded build provenance string printed in the fak guard startup banner.
rows.distinction: It is build identity text for the banner, not the guard decision floor or a gate verdict.

rows.definition: guardPreCompactClaudeCommand is the JSON row shape for one Claude hook command written by the guard precompact/toolproc hook installers.
rows.distinction: It is the command leaf inside the Claude hook settings, not the matcher that owns its hooks nor the settings document.

rows.definition: guardPreCompactClaudeMatcher is the Claude hook settings matcher row that groups one or more guardPreCompactClaudeCommand entries for a hook event.
rows.distinction: It is the matcher container, not the individual command row and not the top-level settings map.

rows.definition: guardPreCompactClaudeSettings is the top-level Claude settings structure whose hook map is updated by guard precompact, stop-hook, and toolproc-hook installation.
rows.distinction: It is the full settings document shape, not a matcher row or command row inside that document.

rows.definition: guardPreCompactHookCommand builds the concrete command line fak writes into Claude hook settings for the precompact hook path.
rows.distinction: It is command-line construction for a hook install, not the serialized Claude command row type.

rows.definition: SessionEnd is the Claude/toolproc hook event that marks the owning agent session ending, letting toolprocgate classify descendants as orphans.
rows.distinction: It is the session-lifecycle boundary event, not a per-turn Stop event and not session reset.

rows.definition: AggregateSessions folds sessionaudit Session rows into aggregate totals, top-model summaries, and pressure inputs for reports.
rows.distinction: It aggregates session rows for audit, not ListSessions, which enumerates sessions from a live API/store.

rows.definition: EvSessionEnd is the internal/toolproc journal event kind for a session_end record emitted when the owning session ends.
rows.distinction: It is the journal event constant, not the Claude SessionEnd hook name that is translated into it.

rows.definition: MTTRSessions is the resume/operator-touches metric for the sessions included when estimating mean time to repair or recovery.
rows.distinction: It is an MTTR analysis metric over sessions, not the active session count or session list.

rows.definition: RecentSessions is the optional compact session-audit report embedded in vCache status output to summarize recent guarded session behavior.
rows.distinction: It is a vCache status summary payload, not the session list endpoint or the sessionaudit aggregator.

rows.definition: internal/sessiondesc holds helpers for writing and reading session descriptors, the small durable shape that points to a live guard session.
rows.distinction: It is the package for descriptor handling, not the leaseref.SessionDescriptor wire record itself.

rows.definition: PolicyDigest is the policy hash metadata carried through guard/accounts/toolproc spawn attempts and leak events to identify the capability floor in force.
rows.distinction: It is provenance for which policy was applied, not the policy manifest or capability floor itself.

rows.definition: adjudicat is the normalized stem the scorecard sees across adjudicate/adjudicated/adjudication wording in guard, policy, and scorecard text.
rows.distinction: It is a discovered terminology stem, not the concrete adjudicator package or an individual adjudication verdict.

rows.definition: CapabilityEnvelope is the structured set of capabilities attached to a toolproc/guard child spawn attempt before the broker admits or denies it.
rows.distinction: It is the per-spawn capability carrier, not the global capability floor or policy manifest.

rows.definition: PreflightVerdict is the dispatch sweep/status field that records the policy preflight result attached to a dispatch trial or candidate card.
rows.distinction: It is a recorded dispatch preflight outcome, not supportmaturity.FromPreflightVerdict's rung mapping.

rows.definition: ColdCache is the rehydrate reason and compact option indicating that the prompt/message-span cache is cold, so a prompt-cache preserving path no longer has warm-cache value to protect.
rows.distinction: It is a cold-state reason/option, not a cache read counter or provider-cache transport capability.

rows.definition: coldMessageSpanCache is the gateway metrics helper that witnesses whether a trace's message-span cache has aged past the provider TTL.
rows.distinction: It is the observed idle-gap cold-cache check, not the ColdCache reason/option propagated into compaction or rehydrate decisions.

rows.definition: RenderLeakReport formats a parsed toolproc leak report for the fak toolproc CLI surface.
rows.distinction: It renders leak-report output, not generic renderReason text nor ctxplan materialization.

rows.definition: renderSleepReason formats repo-guard foreground-sleep violations into a human-readable refusal block.
rows.distinction: It renders sleep-specific guard text, not the generic renderReason helper nor a UI render surface.

rows.definition: WitnessCommands is the recorded list of build, test, or verification commands observed in fleet/session summaries as evidence for a claimed change.
rows.distinction: It records commands used as evidence, not the witness verdict itself.

rows.definition: WitnessOK is the dispatchtick constant value diff-witnessed that marks a claimed resolution as corroborated by the required witness rung.
rows.distinction: It is the accepted witness constant, not the list of commands that produced evidence.

rows.definition: evict_manifest is the vCache provider action that removes a warm row from the fak-owned local provider manifest without claiming a provider-side deletion.
rows.distinction: It evicts a manifest row, not a KV span from a KV cache and not a cachemeta ActionEvict placement decision.

rows.definition: inKernelTok is the tokenizer handle resolved for an in-kernel GGUF model serve or guard run and stored on the serve runtime.
rows.distinction: It is the tokenizer instance used beside the in-kernel model, not the in-kernel engine id or model residency state.

rows.definition: CorrectnessLaw is the vCache action/report field that states the correctness invariant: full uncached prompt execution remains the authoritative path and cache hits are only rebates.
rows.distinction: It is the explicit invariant statement in cache action reports, not the broader correctness concept or support-maturity rung.
